rationale: Only overload is l12 (118 > 100) and it needs at least -18 MW. Single actions are insufficient: open_tie_13 gives 110, shed_bus3_15 gives 104, shed_bus2_10 gives 109. open_tie_13 + shed_bus2_10 gives 101 (still over). open_tie_13 + shed_bus3_15 gives l12 96 and l23 78, both within limits, with 15 MW shed over 2 actions, the minimum-shedding feasible choice. Opening breaker l13 takes line l13 out of service (flow 0).
